description: This file contains tests for error logging functionality within the litellm library, specifically targeting the raw completion and embedding endpoints across various scenarios such as success, failure, streaming, and different APIs.

methods.name: test_logging_success_completion
methods.description: Tests logging output for a successful completion call with the 'gpt-3.5-turbo' model, verifying that specific log messages are present before and after the API call.

methods.name: test_logging_success_streaming_openai
methods.description: Tests logging output during a streaming completion call with the 'gpt-3.5-turbo' model, checking for correct log messages and streaming response logging.

methods.name: test_logging_success_streaming_non_openai
methods.description: Tests logging output during a streaming completion call with a non-OpenAI model ('claude-3-5-haiku-20241022'), verifying log messages and streaming response logs.

methods.name: test_logging_success_embedding_openai
methods.description: Checks logging output for an embedding request using the 'text-embedding-ada-002' model, ensuring pre- and post-call logs are captured.
